epics.title: Automation 1 - GitLab Toolkit
epics.description: First phase of the GitLab automation toolkit: a CLI that mirrors JSON documents into a GitLab group. This phase covers configuration, offline validation, idempotent creation of labels, milestones, epics, user stories and issues, dry run, and the tests and documentation that keep the tool trustworthy.
objectives: Read configuration from a .env file and the environment
Define and document the JSON payload schema for every type
Validate documents offline before anything is written
Discover the documents under data/ and merge their defaults
Resolve project aliases and milestone titles to numeric IDs
Create labels, milestones and issues idempotently
Render user stories with acceptance criteria and definition of done
Preview every write with a dry run
Degrade gracefully on groups without epics
Update existing work through separate update documents
Verify the environment with a doctor command
Cover the tool with an offline test suite and a README
